name: TurboFex
description: TurboFex is a WhatsApp group-management bot: moderation, welcome messages, games, tools and many more commands.

SESSION_ID.description: Your login for the bot. Get it on https://turbofex-pair.onrender.com (it looks like TFX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX).

BOT_PREFIX.description: The symbol that starts every command, for example a dot. One to three characters.

TIMEZONE.description: Your time zone, used for the menu clock and for automatic open and close, for example Africa/Lagos.
